title: NYT Cooking App Tests New AI Recipe Modification Tool
excerpt: The New York Times is testing an AI feature in its Cooking app that allows users to modify recipes, sparking mixed reactions.
body_html:
The New York Times is currently testing a new artificial intelligence feature within its Cooking app. Genevieve Ko, a senior editor for NYT Cooking, announced the addition of the tool.

The feature is designed to help users alter recipes in several ways. It can suggest alternative ingredients and cooking equipment, as well as scale recipes to different portion sizes.

While introduced to assist with kitchen adjustments, the inclusion of the technology has generated discussion and drama among the app's user base.
